title: The Lemon Drop Main House | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: The Lemon Drop Main House is a 3.00 bedroom, 3.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: 3BR/3BA Seacrest Home – Pet Friendly, Spacious & BrightStep into the Main House at Lemon Drop, a light-filled, three-story home designed for comfort and connection. Whether you’re planning a family getaway or a friends’ retreat, this home gives you space to gather, relax, and enjoy life along Scenic 30A with your pets by your side.Your SpaceThis home sleeps up to 8 guests with 3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms. The living area features a fireplace and ample seating for movie nights or quiet evenings after beach days. The fully equipped kitchen includes a coffee maker, Keurig, blender, and toaster, and the dining area seats eight with a breakfast bar for four more. The home also has its own washer and dryer, making longer stays effortless.Outdoor SpacesEnjoy morning coffee or evening sunsets from the balconies off the bedrooms. Out back, the private gas grill and picnic area invite casual outdoor meals. Garage access and parking for up to two vehicles make arrival and departure easy.Sleeping Arrangements1st Floor – Guest Bedroom 1: Queen bed, Jack and Jill bathroom2nd Floor – Guest Bedroom 2: Full bed, balcony access, Jack and Jill bathroom2nd Floor – Primary Bedroom: King bed, balcony access, private bathroom3rd Floor – Loft Area: Daybed with pull-out twin trundleBeach AccessEnjoy private beach access just an 8-minute walk or shuttle hop on the seasonal tram, making beach days easy and hassle-free. The tram provides convenient service to the soft white sands and clear Gulf waters of Seacrest Beach.Seacrest BeachDuring your stay, you can take advantage of the Seacrest community’s amenities, including one of the largest lagoon pools on 30A, ideal for swimming and lounging. Explore Peddler’s Pavilion with local shops, restaurants, bike rentals, and open-air events, or enjoy the neighborhood trails and bike paths for walking, running, or cycling. Community picnic areas and open green spaces provide additional spots to relax outdoors.Location & Local ExperiencesStaying at Lemon Drop House places you close to the activities that make the 30A area special. Start mornings with bike rides along nearby paths, spend afternoons at the beach, and plan evenings around local food and entertainment:* Shades Bar & Grill – casual meals and live music* George’s at Alys Beach – coastal cuisine* Rosemary Beach downtown – including The Pearl, Sugar Shack, boutique shops, and outdoor events* 30Avenue – Amigos, Amici’s, Idyll Proper, and Attycat’s Arcade* The Big Chill – beachfront bar and restaurant with a relaxed vibe, perfect for drinks or casual dining* Watersound Town Center – Publix, Village Market, Ambrosia, Nigel’s, and Sweet Henrietta’sEverything from grocery runs to family-friendly outings is within easy reach.Your stay at The Lemon Drop Main House comes with Xplorie’s best activities! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!Other Details to Note:* Snowbird Friendly!* Golf carts are not allowed in the Seacrest Beach community.* Dog Friendly: If bringing a pet, an additional non-refundable pet fee will be added to your booking. Please contact us if you are bringing a dog. A maximum of 2 dogs is allowed at a maximum of 40 lbs. Please see our rental policies for further details.A Benchmark initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
